topic: Someone finds their college application essay published as an example
text: I can’t help but feel a bit stunned, seeing my college application essay out there, used as an example. It was something so personal, a piece of my life I poured into words, hoping it would open doors. Now, it’s a public document, scrutinized by strangers. I suppose it’s flattering, in a way, that they thought it was good enough to share. But it’s also strange, like a piece of me is out in the world without my permission. I just wish they had asked, or at least let me know. Maybe then, it wouldn’t feel so... exposed.
